newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMROCK SAYS GAINS FIM 80 MLN ON DISPOSAL.
newsitem.headline: TAMROCK SAYS GAINS FIM 80 MLN ON DISPOSAL.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Tamrock Oy said on Monday it sold its subsidiary Oy Tamrotor Ab to Gardner Denver Machinery Inc. of the U.S. for 95 million markka and would book an 80 million markka gain this year.

"The sale price is 95 million markka and that will give rise to a gain of about 80 million markka," Tamrock CEO Jouko Jaakkola told Reuters by telephone, adding that Tamrock would book the gain this year.
The 95 million markka was net of debt, Jaakkola said. Gardner Denver said earlier the gross consideration was 135 million markka.
"This is a continuation of our efforts to focus on our core business operations -- that is, technology related to rock quarrying and transport," he said.
Tamrotor, which manufactures industrial air compressors and components, had net sales of over 110 million markka in 1996 and has 150 employees, Tamrock said in a statement.
